theme: An open day in St. Pete, one week out from Croatia.
greeting: Clear calendar today, Dan — no meetings until tomorrow's noon call. It's the open stretch the Croatia list has been waiting for, with departure now just a week out.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England call at noon
needsAttention.detail: Larissa Ravetto's intro call is tomorrow, Tue Sep 1 at 12:00 PM ET (Zoom). Worth arriving with two or three thoughts on what you want out of the chapter.

needsAttention.title: Warm intro at Brunswick
needsAttention.detail: Jonathan Pasichow introduced you to Lauren Nadig at Brunswick Group, cc'ing you. A reply while it's fresh keeps it moving.

needsAttention.title: Last Dubrovnik night still open
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat hotel and transfer, plus the checked-bag confirmation on the Croatia ticket, all have to be booked from dry land before you fly out Sep 8.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The rotating pantry tote needs building before the Sept 3 house move, so the first migration is a test run while there's still time to fix it.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-21 still needs a room — you land TPA from Croatia before the Tue Sep 22 kid pickup and the Orlando villa starts.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing balance due
flagged.detail: A $6,475 balance on the Croatia course invoice (via QuickBooks) sits open ahead of the Sep 12 start.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley payment review
flagged.detail: An automated payment was flagged for review — a quick glance to confirm you recognize it.

flagged.title: Block public-policy role posted
flagged.detail: LinkedIn alert: Head of US Public Policy & Government Relations at Block, posted Aug 29.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day seafood promos, care.com applicant pings, and your own daily Japanese lesson.

recipe.title: Green Salad with Green Beans
recipe.why: High summer is peak bean season, so a crisp green salad leans on what the garden is giving now.

Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket

acts.line: A clear calendar over the St. Pete stay — the morning is already yours.
Nothing scheduled, which is the room the pre-trip backlog has been waiting for.
The day ends open; tomorrow is where the week starts to tighten.
